# `silk/build/toolchain`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Selects the LLVM tools used by a compiler installation and by build-cache fingerprints.

Import as `Toolchain` with `import silk.build.toolchain as Toolchain`.

Public declarations: 4.

<a id="TOOLS"></a>

## `TOOLS`

```silk
pub const TOOLS: [string<'static>; 9]
```

Tool names supplied by Silk's LLVM installation.

<a id="compiler"></a>

## `compiler`

```silk
pub effect fn compiler(executable: &Path, selected: Option<&[u8]>) -> Option<Path>
  ! FileError | HostInputError | OutOfMemoryError
  ? &mut HostInput | &mut FileSystem | &mut Allocator
```

Selects an explicit Clang, `SILK_CLANG`, the compiler's bundled LLVM, or `clang` on `PATH`.
The compiler path identifies the installation even when this function runs in a task program.

<a id="companion"></a>

## `companion`

```silk
pub effect fn companion(clang: &Path, name: string) -> Path
```

Returns a tool beside Clang, including the Windows executable suffix when needed.


Profiles: `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, `wasm32-wasip1`, `wasm32-wasip2`, `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`, `wasm64-unknown-unknown`.
